articles.title: AutoDesign: Meta-Harness Optimization for Long-Horizon Agentic Design
articles.content: Transforming multimodal sources into condensed and structured media outputs can be fundamentally conceptualized as a long-horizon agentic process centered on a model-harness system. While an ideal harness system should align with human design priors and accumulate reusable experience through empirical exploration to drive recursive self-improvement, existing paradigms remain static and fall short of this capability. In this paper, we present AutoDesign, a framework that aligns with human design priors, where a meta-harness optimizer guides a code agent to recursively improve harness based on rollout feedback. To instantiate and evaluate this framework, we focus on the academic paper-to-poster generation task and introduce PosterBench, comprising a 100-paper Main Track spanning five disciplines and PosterBench-mini, a shared 10-paper subset for controlled evaluation. On the PosterBench Main Track, AutoDesign achieves the highest score of 78.32, surpassing the closed-source commercial system Claude Design by 7.45 points. Across seven controlled code-agent-model configurations, integrating the learned DesignHarness consistently improves performance, increasing the average PosterBench Score from 54.99 to 67.39 (+12.4%). In a fully autonomous long-horizon loop, it executes 253 tool calls and 11 editing turns within 40 minutes for under $3, reaching average conference-poster quality in human evaluation. A system-blind human study further demonstrates that AutoDesign achieves the highest human preference among evaluated systems.

articles.title_zh: 自动设计:用于长线代理设计的Meta-Harness优化
articles.content_zh: 将多式联运源转变为浓缩和结构化的媒体产出,可以从根本上将它视为一个以模型热度系统为中心的长视代理过程。 虽然理想的拉带系统应该与人类的设计前科保持一致,并通过经验探索来积累可重复使用的经验来推动递归自我改进,但现有的范式仍然是静止不变的,并且没有达到这种能力. 在本文中,我们介绍AutoDesign,一个与人类设计前科一致的框架,一个元harness优化器引导一个代码代理基于推出反馈来递归性地改进利用. 为了对这个框架进行即时评估,我们侧重于学术纸对海报生成任务,并引入了Poster Bench, 其中包括一个涵盖五个学科的100份主要文件,以及Poster Bench-mini, 一个用于控制下评价的共用10份文件子集。 在Poster Bench主轨上,AutoDesign取得了78.32的最高分数,以7.45分超过了闭源商业系统Claude Design. 在7个可控制的代号-代理模型配置中,整合学习到的设计Harness持续改善性能,将平均Poster Bench Score从54.99提高到67.39(+12.4%). 在一个完全自主的长视圈中,它执行253个工具呼叫,11个编辑在40分钟内转动,每3美元以下,在人的评价中达到平均的会议贴纸质量. 一项系统盲人类研究进一步表明,自动设计在被评价系统中实现了人类的最高偏好。

articles.title: V-RAE: Rethinking Video Latent Spaces for Generation
articles.content: Latent video generation relies on autoencoders to define a compact space in which generative models operate. Although video autoencoder architectures have evolved substantially, their latent spaces are still optimized primarily for pixel-level reconstruction and provide limited high-level semantic organization. A reconstruction-optimal latent space, however, need not be well suited to generative modeling. We propose V-RAE, a video representation autoencoder that builds compact generative latents on top of frozen vision foundation model representations. A lightweight temporal pooling module removes temporal redundancy while preserving semantic structure, and a video decoder reconstructs continuous motion from the compressed features. We evaluate V-RAE with four representative frozen encoders on video reconstruction, semantic probing, and class-conditional generation. V-RAE achieves 2.13 rFVD on K600, outperforming all evaluated large-scale pretrained video VAEs. Its latents retain substantially more semantic information than conventional video tokenizer latents. Under matched generation settings, our best variant achieves gFVD scores of 117.86 and 19.16 on UCF101 and K600, respectively, while converging up to 6x faster}. We further show that reconstruction quality alone is insufficient to characterize generative utility and introduce tFVD, a temporal-coherence diagnostic that correlates more reliably with downstream generation quality. Beyond video generation, V-RAE also improves future video prediction on Cityscapes over the Wan 2.2 VAE latent space under matched prediction settings. Taken together, the experiments show that frozen semantic representations can support video reconstruction, generation, and predictive modeling. The project page: https://v-rae.github.io/.

articles.title_zh: V-RAE:为一代人重新思考视频后期空间
articles.content_zh: Latent视频生成依赖于自动编码器来定义基因模型运行的紧凑空间. 虽然视频自动编码器架构已发生实质性演变,但其潜在空间仍主要为像素级重建进行优化,并提供有限的高级语义组织. 然而,重建的最佳潜在空间不一定非常适合基因模型。 我们提出V-RAE,一个视频代表自动编码器,在冷冻的视觉基础模型代表之上建立紧凑的基因潜质。 轻量级时间集合模块在保留语义结构的同时消除时间冗余,视频解码器则从压缩功能中重建连续运动. 我们用四个具有代表性的冷冻编码器评估V-RAE, 视频重建,语义测试,以及类条件生成。 V-RAE在K600上实现了2.13 rFVD,表现优于所有被评价的大型预训视频VAE. 它的潜伏物保留了比传统视频示意器潜伏物更多的语义信息. 在匹配的生成设置下,我们的最佳变体在UCF101和K600上分别达到117.86和19.16的gFVD分数,同时汇合到6x更快}. 我们进一步表明,仅靠重建质量不足以确定基因效用和引入tFVD,这种时间一致性诊断与下游的发电质量更可靠。 除了视频生成之外,V-RAE还在匹配的预测设置下,改进了Wan 2.2 VAE潜在空间对Cityscapes的未来视频预测. 综合起来,实验表明,冷冻语义表达可以支持视频重建,生成和预测模型. 项目网页:https://v-rae.github.io/。

articles.title: HumanTracker: Towards Comprehensive and Human-Aligned Motion Tracking Benchmark
articles.content: Humanoid motion tracking is central to teleoperation and whole-body imitation, yet evaluation often disagrees with what people perceive in videos. Kinematic errors average per-frame pose differences but miss the physical artifacts that matter most, particularly unstable support and incorrect contacts such as foot skating and mistimed touch-downs. Meanwhile, widely used test suites are small and lack the diversity needed to stress contact-rich, long-horizon behaviors. We introduce HumanTracker to make humanoid tracking evaluation both perceptually aligned and scalable. The HumanTracker benchmark contains approximately 153 hours of optical motion trajectories from multiple professional performers, organized into four motion families with text labels for fine-grained diagnosis. We further propose HumanScore, a preference-aligned metric trained on 12K motion pairs containing 24K motions. Across representative state-of-the-art trackers, HumanScore better predicts human preferences and reveals contact and stability failures that kinematic metrics often miss.

articles.title_zh: 人类追踪员:实现全面和人与人一致的运动跟踪基准
articles.content_zh: 人体运动跟踪是远程操作和全身模仿的核心,然而评价往往与人们在视频中的看法有分歧. 平均每帧的动因误差构成差异,但错过了最重要的物理文物,尤其是不稳定的支持和不正确的接触,如脚滑冰和误时的触地得分. 同时,广泛使用的测试套房很小,缺乏强调接触丰富,长视距行为所需的多样性. 我们引入了人类追踪器,使人造物跟踪评价既能感知到对齐,又可扩展. HumanTracker基准包含来自多个专业表演者的约153小时光学运动轨迹,组织成四个运动家族,并带有文字标签,用于细纹诊断. 我们进一步提出人类得分,一种以12K运动对包含24K运动对进行训练的偏好比分指标. 在所有具有代表性的先进追踪者中, " 人类记分 " 更好地预测了人类的喜好,并揭示了动态衡量标准经常错过的接触和稳定性故障。

articles.title: PlayWorld: Benchmarking World Models with Agent Players over Long-Horizon Objectives
articles.content: Video world models simulate future states conditioned on current observations and user actions. Recent systems have demonstrated impressive video consistency and action controllability over long sequences. However, fairly comparing these interactive models remains challenging. In practice, a human player typically evaluates a world model by pursuing long-horizon objectives through interaction. For example, a user may turn around 360 degrees to see whether the environment remains consistent, or walk into the water and inspect whether realistic water ripples are generated. The action sequence required to achieve the same objective may vary substantially between models, making fixed action-conditioned evaluation unsuitable for cross-model comparison. To address this, we employ multi-modal Agent Players to interact with world models toward specified long-horizon objectives. Building on this paradigm, we introduce PlayWorld, a benchmark providing 171 scenarios, each with a specified objective. To evaluate performance thoroughly, we assess models along four core dimensions: geometry consistency, interaction fidelity, out-of-sight evolution, and insight evolution. In addition, we incorporate basic ability metrics for video quality and controllability. Experiments across nine state-of-the-art world models reveal that current models remain unreliable on long-horizon interactive objectives, particularly in maintaining spatial consistency and persistent state evolution. Code and data are available at https://github.com/kxding/PlayWorld.

articles.title_zh: PlayWorld:将世界模式与代理玩家放在长视野目标之上
articles.content_zh: 视频世界模型模拟以当前观测和用户行动为条件的未来状态. 近期的系统表现出了令人印象深刻的视频一致性和对长序列的动作可控性. 然而,比较这些互动模式仍然具有挑战性。 在实践中,人类玩家一般通过互动追求长视野目标来评价世界模式. 例如,一个用户可能会转过360度,看看环境是否保持不变,或者走进水中,检查是否产生了现实的水波。 实现同样目标所需的行动顺序可能因不同模式而大不相同,使固定的行动条件评价不适合进行跨模式比较。 为了解决这个问题,我们利用多模式代理玩家与世界模式进行互动,以实现具体的长期目标。 在这个范式的基础上,我们引入了PlayWorld,这个基准提供了171种情景,每种情景都有特定的目标. 为了透彻地评估业绩,我们按照四个核心层面评估模型:几何一致性,相互作用忠贞性,外观进化,以及洞察进化. 此外,我们还纳入了视频质量和控制性的基本能力衡量标准。 跨越9个最先进的世界模型的实验表明,目前的模型对于长距离交互目标来说仍然是不可靠的,特别是在保持空间一致性和持续状态演化方面. 代码和数据见https://github.com/kxding/PlayWorld。

articles.title: Alaya-EVOKE: From Linear-Scaling Supervision to Endless World
articles.content: Interactive world models must support persistent memory, responsive interaction, and long-horizon generation, yet these requirements place conflicting demands on the model. Maintaining history in the denoiser context or key-value cache incurs growing cost, forcing a trade-off between session length and retained memory, while low-latency interaction relies on few-step generation whose capabilities are bounded by its teacher. Evoke addresses both limitations by externalizing persistent world state and redesigning the teacher for long-horizon interactive generation. Scene geometry is maintained in an external, camera-indexed world state bank, from which only view-relevant information is retrieved, keeping the denoiser context bounded as the session grows. Rather than treating the teacher as a fixed generator, we design it for long-horizon supervision: its sparse attention combines chunk-wise grouping, retrieval of selected distant frames, and a linear-attention global state, yielding linear growth in memory and compute while enabling supervision over long horizons. Such supervision exposes content drift that stays locally plausible within short windows, while per-chunk conditioning enables prompt changes and event control throughout the sequence. A 30-second distribution-matching objective, applied under self-forced rollouts, transfers both capabilities to a three-step student that uses no classifier-free guidance, improving resistance to long-term drift while preserving responsive conditioning. With bounded context and recurrent external memory, Evoke supports open-ended, continuously evolving generation; on a single H200 at $384\times 640$, each $1.5\,\mathrm{s}$ chunk is generated in $2.11\,\mathrm{s}$. As a three-step world model, Evoke achieves state-of-the-art performance on WBench while remaining competitive on VBench-Long and VBench-2.0.

articles.title_zh: Alaya-EVOKE:从线性升级监督到无尽世界
articles.content_zh: 互动的世界模式必须支持持续的记忆、反应灵敏的互动和长视距的生成,但这些要求对模式提出了相互矛盾的要求。 在denoiser语境或密钥-值缓存中保持历史会产生越来越大的成本,迫使会话长度和保留内存之间的权衡,而低纬度互动依赖于几步生成,其能力与其老师为界. articles.title: SCULPT: Subtractive Composition for 3D Part Generation
articles.content: Part-aware 3D generation aims to create digital assets that are coherent as complete objects while exposing structural parts for editing, material assignment, animation, and reuse. Existing methods impose this structure outside the native generation loop: segmentation-based methods partition an already generated shape, while additive methods synthesize parts from predefined layouts, boxes, or tokens and then reconcile them into a whole. The former preserves the generated geometry but fixes the object before part boundaries are determined; the latter exposes part cardinality but often leaves shared boundaries vulnerable to gaps, interpenetrations, and material discontinuities. In this paper, we propose SCULPT, a framework that addresses these challenges through subtractive composition. Given a complete object represented in a structured 3D latent space, SCULPT iteratively applies a joint split predictor to generate one extracted part together with the remaining object. The predictor performs a coupled denoising process conditioned on both the image and the current 3D state, so the extracted part and updated remainder are generated together rather than reconciled after generation. The joint split predictor processes both outputs on the union of their native sparse 3D supports, allowing neighboring supports to overlap rather than imposing a disjoint voxel partition. The rollout ends when the remainder support becomes empty or reaches a fixed safety cap, allowing the number of generated parts to adapt to each object within that bound. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art geometry on PartObjaverse while preserving strong complete-object reconstruction after part assembly. Results on four dataset images, one text-to-image-generated input, and one real-world photograph further show fine-grained textured part decomposition beyond the benchmark.

articles.title_zh: SCULPT: 3D 组件生成的亚构件
articles.content_zh: 部分意识的3D生成旨在创造作为完整对象的一致数字资产,同时将结构部件暴露于编辑,材料分配,动画,再利用. 现有方法将这种结构强加于原生生成回路之外:以分块法为基础的方法分割出已经生成的形状,而添加法则从预先定义的布局,框,或符合成出部分,再将它们调和成整体. 前者保留生成的几何特征,但在部分边界确定之前就固定了对象;后者暴露出部分基本特征,但往往使共享边界易受空白、互通和物质不连续的影响。 在本文中,我们提议设立SCULPT,这是一个通过减法组成来应对这些挑战的框架。 鉴于一个在结构化的3D潜在空间中代表的完整对象,SCULPT迭代地应用了联合分解预测器,以生成一个被取出的部分和所剩的物体. 预测器执行一个以图像和当前3D状态为条件的组合去诺过程,因此取出的部分和被更新的剩余部分是一起生成的,而不是在生成后调和. 联合分解预测器处理两种输出在他们本地稀有的3D支持的结合上,允许相邻支持重叠而不是强制进行脱节的voxel分区. 当剩余支持变为空或达到固定的安全上限时,推出即告结束,使生成的部件数量能够适应该约束范围内的每个对象. 广泛的实验演示了PartObjaverse上最先进的几何学,同时在部分组装后保留了强大的完整对象重建. 4个数据集图像的结果,1个文本到图像生成的输入,1个真实世界相片进一步显示精细纹理部分分解超过基准.

articles.title: Intervention-Aware Clinical World Model for Post-Op Outcome Forecasting in Cardiology
articles.content: Many clinical prediction models treat post-intervention outcomes as a one-step mapping from baseline measurements to a future endpoint. However, recovery after a procedure often unfolds as an irregular trajectory: clinical observations, medication changes, repeat interventions, and physiological measurements are recorded asynchronously and can change risk assessment over time. We propose an intervention-aware clinical world model that represents each patient with a structured latent state and evolves it through time-ordered post-intervention events. The model first encodes baseline imaging into a 3D spatial latent state. It then updates this state using procedural context, static covariates, elapsed time, and peri-event physiological embeddings. Follow-up imaging provides training-only supervision through a latent forecasting objective. We apply the framework to atrial fibrillation ablation. During the 90-day recovery window, irregular post-procedure records provide clinically meaningful evidence for long-term recurrence risk. In repeated internal cross-validation on DECAAF-II, our model achieves AUROC 0.756 and AUPRC 0.777 for recurrence prediction. It also achieves a scar-extent MAE of 2.971 percentage points without requiring follow-up MRI intensities at inference. The learned state supports recurrence-risk queries at different horizons and retrospective input editing of blanking-period records.

articles.title_zh: 防患于未然
articles.content_zh: 许多临床预测模型将干预后的结果视为从基线测量到未来终点的一步图. 然而,经过一个程序之后的恢复往往作为不规则的轨迹进行:临床观察、药物改变、重复干预和生理测量都是同步记录的,并且可以随着时间的推移改变风险评估。 我们提出了一个具有干预意识的临床世界模型,它代表每个具有结构化潜伏状态的病人,并通过按时排序的干预后事件来演化。 该模型首先将基线成像编码为3D空间潜伏状态. 然后利用程序上下文、静态共变、过后时间和近事生理嵌入来更新这一状态。 后续成像通过潜在的预测目标提供只培训的监督。 我们把框架应用到 审判性纤维分泌上 在90天的恢复窗口中,不规则的程序后记录为长期重现风险提供了临床上有意义的证据. 在DEAAF-II的反复内部交叉验证中,我们的模型实现了AUROC 0.756和AUPRC 0.777的重现预测. 它还达到2.971个百分点的疤痕多效率,无需在推论中采取后续核磁共振强度。 所学状态支持不同视野的重现-风险查询以及对空白期记录的回溯输入编辑.

articles.title: TabSOM: A tabular-to-image encoding method based on self-organizing maps
articles.content: Tabular-to-image methods have emerged as novel approaches to leverage the high predictive performance of convolutional neural networks and vision transformers. They convert tabular data into image representations, mapping each feature at a fixed pixel location derived from a dimensionality-reduction method (e.g., t-SNE, UMAP, PCA). However, they encode only the marginal value of each feature and discard information about feature relationships. We propose TabSOM, a tabular-to-image encoding built on the Self-Organizing Map (SOM), which provides: (i) a spatial layout in which every input feature occupies a fixed canvas position derived from its component plane via collision-free Hungarian assignment; and (ii) a graph that captures pairwise feature relationships derived from the SOM component planes. The resulting image stacks two multi-scale node channels: one encodes feature values at fixed scales, while the other encodes pairwise feature interactions as spatial connections between related features. Two SOM-derived interpretability approaches are introduced: a prototype-inspired partial dependence plot and a class--separation importance score. Benchmarked against twelve existing tabular-to-image methods across public binary-classification datasets, TabSOM ranks first or second on every dataset and achieves the lowest variance of any method evaluated. Interpretability obtained with TabSOM was validated against Random Forest, XGBoost, and SHAP, the class-separation score shows reasonable agreement with established baselines on the top-ranked features while capturing complementary structural information from input data. These results demonstrate that TabSOM provides an effective and interpretable approach for applying deep learning architectures to tabular data, bridging the performance--interpretability gap in this domain.

articles.title_zh: TabSOM:基于自组织化地图的表格到图像编码方法
articles.content_zh: 以表形变相方法作为新颖的方法,来利用进化神经网络和视觉变相器的高预测性能. 它们将表格数据转换为图像表示,在从维度-还原法(如t-SNE,UMAP,PCA)得到的固定像素位置上绘制出每个特性. 然而,它们只编码每个特性的边际值并丢弃关于特性关系的信息. 我们提议采用TabSOM这一基于自组织化地图(SOM)的表格到图像编码,它规定:(一) 空间布局,每个输入特性通过匈牙利无相撞任务占据其组件平面产生的固定布局位置;以及(二) 显示由SOM组件平面产生的对等特征关系的图表。 由此产生的图像堆放出两个多尺度的节点通道:一个是固定尺度的编码特征值,而另一个是成对编码特征的互动作为相关特征之间的空间连接. 采用了两种SOM衍生的可解释性方法:原型启发部分依赖情节和分级重要性分数. 参照公共二进制分类数据集的12个现有表格对图像方法,TabSOM在每个数据集中排名第一或第二,并实现了所评价方法的最低差异。 与 TabSOM 获得的可解释性被验证为针对 Random Forest, XGBooost, 和 SHAP, 类分离分数显示在获取输入数据的补充结构信息的同时,与排名最高的特征上的既定基线有合理的一致. 这些结果表明,TabSOM为将深层学习架构应用于表格数据提供了有效和可解释的方法,弥补了该领域的性能-可解释性差距.

articles.title: Intern-S2-Preview: Scientific Agentic Foundation Model
articles.content: Scientific discovery increasingly requires AI systems that can reason over scientific evidence of heterogeneous modalities, interact with scientific tools and environments, and sustain progress across long task horizons. We present Intern-S2-Preview, a series of scientific agentic foundation models designed to support multimodal scientific understanding, reasoning, generation, and long-horizon tasks. The training pipeline begins with scientific multimodal pre-training over rendered scientific documents, interleaved image-text data, and diverse scientific corpora. Starting from the pretrained checkpoint, we apply a unified post-training pipeline consisting of supervised fine-tuning, scalable multi-task reinforcement learning (RL), black- and white-box agentic RL, and on-policy distillation. This pipeline is supported by practical techniques that improve rollout and training stability and efficiency, including partial rollout with off-policy correction, adaptive length regularization, online speculative decoding, robust multi-task optimization, and trace-aware experience assembly for agentic tasks. At the architecture level, Intern-S2-Preview-397B extends time series modelling from efficient long-sequence understanding to numerical forecasting, while Memory Decoder is studied as a separate memory-augmented path for rapid scientific specialization without modifying the frozen 397B backbone. Evaluations across scientific, multimodal, agentic, and general-purpose benchmarks show that Intern-S2-Preview-397B achieves competitive or leading results in multiple settings. The time series modules improve scientific signal understanding and forecasting on SciTS, while the separate Intern-MemDec-4B extension improves the Biology-Instructions average score from 56.92 to 60.32 without modifying the frozen 397B backbone.

articles.title: GS$^{2}$CI: Robust Gaussian Splatting For Snapshot Compressive Imaging via Large Vision Model Priors
articles.content: Snapshot Compressive Imaging (SCI) offers an efficient solution for high-speed video acquisition and, under exposure-time camera--scene relative motion, multi-view scene capture by compressing temporal or spatial information into a single 2D measurement. While recent studies have explored SCI for 3D scene reconstruction, existing methods struggle with significant challenges due to information loss, limited viewpoint diversity, and the computational burden of jointly optimizing 3D representations and camera poses. In this work, we propose a novel framework that reconstructs high-quality 3D scenes from a single SCI measurement by leveraging 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) and the powerful priors of large-scale vision foundation models (VFMs). Our primary reconstruction combines measurement-derived 3D VFM initialization with SCI-aware Gaussian optimization. After coarse-stage convergence, an auxiliary 2D VFM provides pseudo-view supervision at synthesized viewpoints for local appearance refinement. To further address the instability caused by ambiguous SCI supervision during 3DGS optimization, we introduce Opacity-Guided Splitting and Growth Regulation (OSGR), an SCI-specific densification strategy that augments split candidates using local opacity statistics, discourages loss-compensating opacity inflation through mean-opacity regulation, and bounds representation growth with explicit candidate-ratio and Gaussian-count constraints. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves the strongest overall performance, combining leading reconstruction quality and robustness to viewpoint variation with competitive computational efficiency.

articles.content_zh: 快照压缩成像(SCI)为高速视频获取提供了高效的解决方案,在曝光时相机-场景相对运动下,通过将时间或空间信息压缩成单一2D测量,实现多景场景捕捉. 近期的研究探索了3D场景重建的SCI,而由于信息丢失,观点多样性有限,以及联合优化3D表现和相机构成的计算负担等原因,现有方法遇到了重大挑战. 在这部作品中,我们提出了一个新颖的框架,通过利用3D高斯平板电脑(3DGS)和大型视觉基础模型(VFMs)的强大前身,从单一SCI测量中重建出高质量的3D场景. 我们的主要重建结合了测量衍生出3D VFM初始化与SCI-aware高斯优化. 在粗相相会合后,辅助的2D VFM在合成的观点上提供伪视监督,以进行局部外观的完善. 为了进一步解决3DGS优化期间模糊的SCI监管造成的不稳定问题,我们采用了不透明指导分化和增长监管(OSGR),这是一种SCI特有的密度化战略,利用当地不透明统计数据增加被分化的候选人,通过平均不透明监管来抑制损失补偿不透明通货膨胀,并将代表性增长与明确的候选人比例和高斯计算限制相限制。 跨越多个基准的广泛实验表明,我们的方法取得了最强的总体业绩,把领先的重建质量和稳健性结合起来,看待变化和竞争性计算效率。

articles.title: TraVEL: Trajectory-Guided Video Embedding Learning for Driving-Video Retrieval
articles.content: Efficiently retrieving relevant clips from large-scale driving logs is essential for data curation, model development, and safety analysis. Structured and rule-based retrieval systems can explicitly target driving events, but typically require expert-defined rules, auxiliary data, and multi-stage perception pipelines. Multimodal embedding models offer a simpler and more efficient alternative by representing each video with a single searchable vector. However, general-purpose models often rely on shortcuts from static scene context and struggle to distinguish motion-centric events, such as turning left versus right or accelerating versus decelerating. In this work, we study how to adapt a general-purpose multimodal embedding model to driving-video retrieval. We first fine-tune Qwen3-VL-Embedding on paired clips and reasoning traces from nuReasoning using an InfoNCE objective. While this stage substantially improves overall retrieval, caption supervision alone remains insufficient for fine-grained motion understanding. We therefore introduce TraVEL (Trajectory-Guided Video Embedding Learning), a motion-aware fine-tuning framework that uses ego-trajectory similarity as a reward within Group Relative Policy Optimization. Trajectories serve only as privileged training supervision; retrieval still operates on single-vector video embeddings without ego poses, expert rules, or auxiliary perception outputs. We further construct a driving-video retrieval benchmark from nuReasoning. Experiments show that TraVEL improves motion-centric retrieval across model scales: relative to SFT, it raises longitudinal and lateral mAP by 9.8 and 4.7 points at 2B, with corresponding gains of 7.2 and 1.5 points at 8B. TraVEL thus combines physically grounded supervision with efficient embedding-based search.

articles.title_zh: TRAVEL: 传导-引导视频 嵌入式学习,用于驾驶-视频检索
articles.content_zh: 从大型驾驶日志中有效取回相关剪辑对于数据整理、模型开发和安全分析至关重要。 结构化和有章可循的检索系统可以明确瞄准驱动事件,但通常需要专家定义的规则,辅助数据,以及多阶段感知管道. 多式联运嵌入模型提供了一种更简单、更有效率的替代方案,将每个视频都用一个单一的可搜索矢量来代表。 然而,通用模型往往依靠从静态场景背景的捷径来区分以运动为中心的事件,如左转对右或加速对减速. 在这项工作中,我们研究如何使通用多式嵌入模型适用于驱动视频检索。 我们首先微调了Qwen3 -VL -Embedding 在对接的剪辑和推理痕迹 从nuReasoning使用InfoNCE目标。 虽然这一阶段大大改进了总体检索,但仅对字幕的监督不足以理解精细的运动。 因此,我们引入了TRAVEL(Trajectory-Guided Video Embedding Learning),这是一个运动意识的微调框架,使用自负-弹射相似性作为集团相对政策优化的奖励. 轨迹只是作为特权的培训监督;检索仍然在单向视频嵌入上操作,没有自负的姿势,专家规则,或辅助感知输出. 我们进一步构建了从nuReasoning的驱动视频检索基准. 实验显示,TRAVEL改进了跨模型尺度的以运动为中心取回:相对于SFT,它在2B时提升了9.8分和4.7分的纵向和横向mAP,在8B时相应的增分为7.2分和1.5分. 因此,TraVEL将基于实体的监督与基于嵌入的有效搜索结合起来。

articles.title: DreamX-Phi 1.0: Action-Conditioned Video World Model for Robotic Manipulation
articles.content: We present \textbf{DreamX-Phi 1.0}, an action-conditioned video world model for robotic manipulation that, given an observed frame, a language instruction, and a prescribed action sequence comprising end-effector poses and gripper states, predicts the resulting future observations. Yet realism alone does not guarantee faithfulness: a convincing rollout can still move the wrong arm or lose the manipulated object. To ensure the prediction respects each arm's commanded path, we inject per-arm $\mathrm{SE}(3)$ transformations into attention via \textbf{PRoPE-style geometric encoding}, preserving arm identity and rigid-motion structure. Action control alone does not fully constrain scene geometry or the evolution of small manipulated objects. We therefore add a lightweight \textbf{depth branch} for scene-level geometry and use \textbf{SAM3 masks} with a frozen \textbf{V-JEPA teacher} to maintain object consistency throughout grasping. We further distill the multi-step generator into a few-step student via distribution-matching distillation for efficient deployment. At the time of writing, \model{} achieves first place on Track~1 and second place on Track~2 of the WorldArena~2.0 Challenge. Our model and code will be publicly available.

articles.title: MapRoute++: Surrogate-Guided Semantic Routing for Visual Concept Unlearning
articles.content: We present our submission to Task 3 of the Gen$μ$ 2.0 Challenge on visual concept unlearning. Building on MapRoute, we introduce task-specific training objectives, richer concept representations, and semantic routing for concept-specific mapper selection. Our approach improves robust concept removal while preserving unrelated and semantically adjacent concepts. On the official benchmark, evaluated using the Erasing-Retention-Robustness (ERR) metric on Stable Diffusion v1.4, our method outperforms the state-of-the-art baseline by 12.1\% on average across the five concept categories, achieving substantial gains.

articles.title: MLLM-Routed Heterogeneous Ensembles for Robust Cross-Dataset Image Classification
articles.content: Modern image classification models excel when trained on single task-specific datasets but often struggle to generalize across domains and difficulty levels. We propose ARMDIL, an Adaptive Router for Multi-Domain Image classification with LLMs. ARMDIL is an ensemble that uses a multimodal large language model (MLLM) agent to dynamically route each image to the most suitable vision backbone. Our diverse ensemble employs convolutional neural networks (ResNets), self-supervised representation learners (SSL), and vision-language models (VLMs), each trained on a unified label space constructed from multiple image datasets with differing distributions and characteristics. Empirical evaluations illuminate the distinct capabilities and vulnerabilities of each architecture across disparate visual domains. Crucially, we show that ARMDIL effectively navigates these trade-offs, performing competitively with specialized training-based routers. Furthermore, it drastically improves adaptability by allowing new information to be integrated via simple prompt modifications, while enhancing interpretability through natural language reasoning traces. These advances in cross-dataset image classification pave the way for more reliable general-purpose vision systems such as AI assistants and autonomous robots.

ARMDIL是一个综艺节目,使用多模式大语言模型代理(MLLM)将每个图像动态地引导到最合适的视觉主干线. 我们多样化的综艺节目采用革命神经网络(ResNets),自我监督的表达学习者(SSL)和视觉语言模型(VLMs),每个单元都接受过从多个分布和特征不同的图像数据集所构建的统一标签空间的培训. 经验评价揭示了每个结构在不同的视觉领域的独特能力和脆弱性。 关键是,我们表明ARMDIL有效导航这些取舍,与专业培训路由器竞争。 此外,它通过简单的即时修改使新信息得到整合,同时通过自然语言推理痕迹增强可解释性,大大提高了适应性。 这些跨数据集图像分类的进步为AI助手和自主机器人等更可靠的通用视觉系统铺平了道路.

articles.title: SNM-VFI: Symmetric Nonlinear Motion-Guided Generative Video Frame Interpolation
articles.content: We propose Symmetric Nonlinear Motion-guided Generative Video Frame Interpolation (SNM-VFI), a training-free framework for motion-controllable generative video frame interpolation with pre-trained optical flow and video diffusion models. Unlike conventional diffusion-based VFI methods that synthesize intermediate frames from random noise, SNM-VFI guides the generative process with correspondence-aware frames produced by a symmetric nonlinear motion model. Specifically, we first utilize a pre-trained optical flow model to construct multi-frame nonlinear flow-based intermediate frames and confidence maps. These flow-guided frames are then encoded as latent priors to initialize and iteratively guide a pre-trained Video Diffusion model, enabling the diffusion model to preserve dense motion correspondence while improving perceptual realism. To further enhance output quality, we employ confidence maps to fuse structurally reliable flow-based predictions with diffusion-generated details in uncertain regions such as occlusions and object boundaries. Extensive evaluations on challenging benchmarks, including DAVIS, Sintel, and KITTI, demonstrate that SNM-VFI achieves strong perceptual quality, competitive reconstruction accuracy, and robust temporal coherence across diverse motion scenarios.

articles.title: Fine-Grained Action Recognition with Cross-Attentive Latent Sparse Experts
articles.content: Fine-grained human action recognition (FHAR) must distinguish visually similar actions that differ mainly in body configuration, timing, or local appearance. RGB representations retain visual context but often suppress joint-level geometry, whereas skeleton representations encode kinematics but discard dense spatial detail. We introduce FineX, which factorizes fine-grained cues into RGB appearance, pose heatmap geometry, and skeletal-graph topology. Pairwise cross-attention enables symmetric, stream-preserving information exchange, followed by a streamwise latent sparse Mixture-of-Experts that routes each representation to a content-dependent subset of shared experts, regularized by a load-balancing objective. FineX achieves state-of-the-art results on Gym99, Gym288, and Diving48. On the long-tailed Gym288, it raises mean class accuracy from 68.6% to 76.2% (+7.6 points) without textual supervision or large-scale vision-language pre-training, demonstrating the benefit of structured visual-pose-graph fusion and conditional expert refinement for FHAR.

RGB表示保留了视觉上下文,但经常会压制关节几何,而骨架表示编码为动能,但丢弃了密集的空间细节. 我们引入了FineX,它将精细的分泌出入到RGB外观中,呈现出热映射几何,以及骨骼-地貌. 双向交叉可实现对称的、分流的信息交流,然后是分流的、潜在的分散的专家混合,通过负载平衡目标,将每个代表物引向一个依赖内容的共享专家子集。 FineX在Gym99,Gym288和Diving48上取得了最先进的成绩. 在长尾Gym288上,它将平均班级精度从68.6%提高到76.2%(+7.6分),没有文字监督或大规模视觉语言预训,显示出结构化视觉pose-graph聚变和有条件的专家完善对FHAR的好处.

articles.title: A Unifying Perspective on Causal World Models: From Observations to Representations to Structure
articles.content: World Models (WM) are increasingly seen as a foundation for intelligent agents that can predict, plan, and act beyond their training distribution. In this paper, we study WMs from a causal perspective across multiple levels of abstraction, ranging from perceptual observations to building a conceptual representation of the structure governing the environment dynamics. We argue that useful WMs must go beyond generative capabilities alone: they should also capture entity properties, entity-to-entity interactions, and entity-to-environment interactions that determine and explain the dynamics of a system. We provide a formal definition of Causal WMs (CWMs) grounded in the tasks they are intended to support, connecting world modelling with existing work in causal representation learning, object-centric learning, causal discovery, structural causal models, and model-based decision-making. Finally, we relate CWMs to the literature on identifiability, clarifying when the components of a WM can be recovered from data and up to which equivalence. With this, we ground WMs in representations and structures that support causal reasoning and informed decision-making.

articles.title_zh: 关于因果世界模式的统一观点:从观察到表现到结构
articles.content_zh: 世界模型公司(WM)日益被视为智慧代理商的基础,它们能够预测、规划和行动,超越其培训分布。 在本文中,我们从多个抽象层次的因果角度研究温床,从概念观察到建立环境动态结构的概念代表。 我们主张,有益的妇幼保健必须超越基因能力本身:它们还应捕捉决定和解释系统动态的实体属性、实体与实体之间的相互作用以及实体与环境之间的相互作用。 我们为Causal WMs(CWMs)提供了一个正式的定义,其基础是它们打算支持的任务,将世界建模与因果表示学习、以对象为中心的学习、因果发现、结构因果模型和以模型为基础的决策的现有工作联系起来。 最后,我们将CWMs与关于可识别性的文献联系起来,澄清何时可从数据中取回WM的组件,以及达到何种等同. 以此为基础,我们支持因果推理和知情决策的各种陈述和结构。

articles.title: Evaluation of Clinically Steerable Retinal Image Generation from Foundation Model Latent Spaces
articles.content: Medical foundation models learn latent representations of clinically meaningful phenotypes, yet their ability to support controllable image generation remains largely unexplored. We evaluate four retinal foundation models within the representation tokenizer framework and examine whether demographic and clinical information encoded in latent representations from foundation models is preserved during synthetic image generation. We show that generated representations and images faithfully inherit phenotype information when evaluated within their originating foundation models, consistently outperforming conventional latent diffusion on multiple downstream prediction tasks. However, these gains largely disappear when evaluated using classifiers trained on real images, revealing a previously uncharacterised synthetic-to-real representation gap. These findings demonstrate that foundation-model latent spaces provide a powerful substrate for controllable retinal synthesis while highlighting the need to better align synthetic representations with real-image distributions.

articles.title_zh: 评价从基础模型Latet空间生成临床可引导视网膜图像
articles.content_zh: 医学基础模型学习临床上有意义的苯基的潜在表现,但其支持可控图像生成的能力基本上仍未被探索. 我们评价了在表示符号框架内的4个视网膜基础模型,并审查在合成图像生成过程中是否保存了从基础模型中潜在表示编码的人口和临床信息。 我们显示,生成的表示和图像忠实地继承了在其原始基础模型中评价的苯基类信息,在多个下游预测任务上一贯表现优于常规潜在传播。 然而,这些收益在使用接受过真实图像培训的分类人员进行评价时基本上消失了,揭示了以前没有特征的合成-实际代表差距。 这些研究结果表明,基础模型潜在空间为可控视网膜合成提供了强大的底物,同时强调需要更好地使合成表示与真实图像分布相匹配。

articles.title: UniTexture: Cross-Task Universal Adversarial Textures for Vision-Language-Action Models
articles.content: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as generalist robotic policies capable of following diverse language instructions and performing a wide range of manipulation tasks. However, their direct control over embodied agents also exposes them to adversarial interference that may cause unsafe physical behaviors. Existing attacks on robotic policies are typically optimized for a single task or instruction, leaving the cross-task vulnerabilities of multitask VLAs largely unexplored. We introduce UniTexture, a cross-task universal adversarial texture attack that uses a single textured 3D object to induce targeted deviations in VLA action predictions across multiple tasks. UniTexture backpropagates gradients from the policy's action outputs to surface texture parameters through a differentiable renderer. It jointly optimizes the shared texture over a distribution of tasks, instructions, states, and viewpoints using a targeted action-space objective, steering predicted actions toward attacker-defined targets without optimizing a separate texture for each task. We evaluate UniTexture on OpenVLA and $π_{0.5}$ across diverse manipulation tasks and multiple evaluation settings. UniTexture reduces the mean task success rate from 90.0% under benign conditions to 48.4% under attack, induces target-aligned action shifts, and further exhibits cross-suite and cross-model transfer without re-optimization. Together, these findings reveal shared cross-task vulnerabilities in multitask VLAs that can be systematically exploited through a single adversarial surface texture.

articles.title_zh: UniTexture:愿景-语言-行动模式的跨任务通用横向纹理
articles.content_zh: 愿景-语言-行动(VLA)模式已作为通俗主义机器人政策而出现,能够遵循多种语言指令并履行广泛的操纵任务. 然而,他们对所表现的代理人的直接控制也使他们面临对抗性干扰,这可能导致不安全的身体行为. 现有的机器人政策攻击通常被优化为单一任务或指令,使得多任务VLA的交叉任务弱点基本上没有得到探讨. 我们引入了UniTexture,是一种跨任务通用对抗纹理攻击,它使用单个有纹理的3D对象来诱发跨多个任务的VLA动作预测中的定向偏差. UniTexture通过可分解的渲染器,将策略的动作输出到表面纹理参数的梯度进行分解. 它利用目标明确的行动空间目标,在分配任务、指示、状态和观点时,共同优化共享的纹理,将预测的行动导向攻击者定义的目标,而不优化每项任务的单独纹理。 我们评价OpenVLA上的UnitTexture和0.5美元,涉及各种操纵任务和多种评价设置。 UniTexture将平均任务成功率从良性条件下的90.0%降低到被攻击时的48.4%,诱发目标相通的动作转变,并在没有再优化的情况下进一步展示跨套和跨模型的转移. 这些调查结果共同揭示了在多任务越共中共同的跨任务脆弱性,这种脆弱性可以通过单一的对抗性表面纹理加以系统利用。

articles.title: Edit2TikZ: A Comprehensive and Challenging Benchmark for Scientific Figure Editing with TikZ
articles.content: Although multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown substantial potential in visual understanding and graphic code generation, editing scientific figures through code presents a greater challenge: a model must jointly recover visual structure, ground the requested change, generate compilable code, and preserve all unrelated content. While existing TikZ benchmarks mainly focus on figure reconstruction and generation, few systematically evaluate instruction-guided scientific figure editing with compilable code. We introduce Edit2TikZ, a comprehensive benchmark for scientific figure editing tasks, featuring 1,548 diverse and high-quality samples. Edit2TikZ combines real-world and controlled synthetic edit cases, supports both textual and visual localization request, and contains multi-step editing, each with step-level annotations. We further construct a human-aligned evaluation framework to measure whether a requested edit is completed while irrelevant content is preserved. Utilizing Edit2TikZ, we evaluate 14 mainstream MLLMs and find that current systems remain unreliable: on average, proprietary models achieve a compilation success rate of merely 75% and remain limited in both figure restoration and edit correctness, while compact models below 9B struggle further with instruction following and complete figure generation. Therefore, we build a mixed training set TikZEditMix and adopt reconstruction-then-editing curriculum learning for compact models. On Qwen3.5-4B, this training improves the compilation success rate from 45.35% to 83.40% and yields an average improvement of 18.7 points across our proposed evaluation metrics. The code and data will be released at https://github.com/Solunny/Edit2TikZ.

articles.title_zh: Edit2TikZ:用TikZ编辑科学图的综合挑战基准
articles.content_zh: 虽然多模式大语言模型(MLLMs)在视觉理解和图形代码生成方面显示出了巨大潜力,但通过代码编辑科学数字则带来了更大的挑战:一个模型必须共同恢复视觉结构,对所请求的更改进行平地,生成可编译的代码,并保存所有无关的内容. 虽然现有的TikZ基准主要侧重于数字的再生和生成,但很少系统评价以可编译的代码进行指导性科学人物编辑. 我们介绍了Edit2TikZ,这是科学人物编辑任务的综合基准,包含1,548个多样和高质量的样本。 Edit2TikZ结合了现实世界和被控制的合成编辑案例,支持文字和视觉本地化请求,并包含多步编辑,每步都带有阶梯级说明. 我们进一步构建了与人相适应的评价框架,以衡量请求的编辑是否完成,同时保留无关的内容。 使用Edit2TikZ,我们评估了14个主流的MLLM,发现目前的系统仍然不可靠:平均来说,专有模型的编译成功率只有75%,在图修复和编辑正确性方面仍然有限,而9B以下的紧凑模型则进一步与指令相搏并完成图生成. 因此,我们建造了一套混合培训教材TikZEditMix,并为紧凑的模型采用重建时编辑的课程学习。 在Quen3.5-4B方面,这一培训提高了汇编成功率,从45.35%提高到83.40%,在我们提议的评价指标中平均提高了18.7分。 该代码和数据将在https://github.com/Solunny/Edit2TikZ发布.

articles.title: ContactGuard: Pre-Contact Execution Monitoring with Action-Conditioned Latent World Models
articles.content: Contact-rich manipulation failures are often detected only after the robot has committed to contact. This is especially limiting in wrist-camera setups: close gripper--object views help observe contact, but a poor approach may already push, miss, slip, or disturb the object before conventional detectors react. We introduce \emph{ContactGuard}, a pre-contact execution monitor for chunked visuomotor policies. Given the policy's planned action chunk, ContactGuard predicts its short-horizon consequence in latent visual space and aborts if the predicted future latent indicates likely failure. Its latent world model is trained from unlabelled robot trajectories to predict compact multi-view visual embeddings under planned actions, avoiding pixel-level video prediction. A lightweight failure probe is then trained from a small labelled set of pre-contact clips. At deployment, ContactGuard anchors prediction before an imminent contact event, rolls the model forward under the policy's own actions, and verifies the predicted post-contact latent. Across real-world contact-rich manipulation tasks, ContactGuard predicts failure more accurately than direct and corrupted-action ablations, and transfers to live robot as a pre-contact abort signal without modifying the underlying policy.

articles.title_zh: ContactGuard:与有行动条件的Latet World Models建立联系前执行监测
articles.content_zh: 接触丰富的操纵故障往往只有在机器人承诺接触后才被检测出. 这在手腕-相机设置中特别受限:近距离的抓取-对象视图有助于观察接触,但不良的方法在常规探测器反应前可能已经推倒,错过,滑倒或扰动物体. 我们引入 \ emph{ ContactGuard}, 一个针对块式粘接器策略的接触前执行监视器 。 鉴于该政策计划的行动块,ContactGuard预测其在潜在视觉空间的短视后果,如果预测的未来潜伏表明可能失败,则流产. 其潜伏的世界模型从无标签的机器人轨迹中被训练出在所计划的行动下预测紧凑的多视图视觉嵌入,避免了像素级的视频预测. 轻量级的故障探测器然后从一小套贴有标签的预接触片段被训练出. 在部署时,联系守护组织在即将到来的联系活动之前进行预测,在政策本身的行动下将模型推向前进,并核查预测的接触后潜伏情况。 在整个真实世界的接触丰富的操纵任务中,ContactGuard预测失败比直接和被腐蚀的动作起爆更准确,并将活的机器人作为接触前中止信号转移,而不修改基本政策.

articles.title: StreamTTT: Reconciling Real-Time Perception and Long-Term Memory in Streaming VLMs
articles.content: Humans effortlessly perceive the present while remembering the past, yet streaming VLMs often trade off real-time perception against long-term memory. Prior work shows that shortening the context can sharpen current-scene perception at the expense of long-range recall. To reconcile these abilities, we introduce StreamTTT, which writes long-range history into online-updated fast weights outside the attention context. This leaves a short sliding key-value cache dedicated to recent evidence, mitigating attention dilution. We train StreamTTT jointly on offline long-video QA and a newly constructed real-time QA corpus. On OVO-Bench, StreamTTT-4B outperforms SimpleStream-4B by 1.4 points in real-time perception and 3.7 points in backward tracing. It also remains competitive with the larger SimpleStream-8B on the Real-Time Visual Understanding (RTVU) subset of StreamingBench. Our code will be released.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: StreamTT:调和流出VLM中的实时感知和长期内存
articles.content_zh: 人类在铭记过去的同时,不遗余力地看待现在,然而流传的VLM往往以实时感知取舍于长期记忆. 先前的研究表明,缩短上下文可以使当前场景的感想更加清晰而牺牲了远程召回. 为了调和这些能力,我们引入了StreatTTT,它将远程历史写入了关注背景之外的在线更新快重. 这留下了一个简短的滑动键值缓存,专门用于最近的证据,缓解了注意力的稀释. 我们联合在下线的长视频QA上进行StreatTT培训,并新建了"QAAAAA". 在 OVO- Bench 上, StreamTT-4B 的成绩超过 SimpleStream-4B在实时感知中以1.4分和后向追踪中以3.7分. 它还与更大型的SimpleStream-8B在Streaming Bench的实时视觉理解子集上保持竞争力. 我们的密码会公布的

articles.title: Context-Matched Distillation: Teacher Causality for Autoregressive Video Distillation
articles.content: Interactive autoregressive video generation demands both low-latency rollouts and precise online control. Few-step distillation accelerates generation by reducing denoising steps, while online control imposes a causal constraint: frames and blocks should depend on history and controls available during generation. Existing video distribution matching distillation (DMD) pipelines, however, often supervise causal few-step students using bidirectional teachers that score complete clips. The score for a target can therefore depend on future frames and controls that were unavailable when the student generated it, misaligning teacher supervision with the student's causal information set. We introduce Context-Matched Distillation (CMD), a causal DMD framework that aligns teacher supervision with the information available when each target is generated. CMD replaces bidirectional full-clip scoring with a causal teacher that evaluates each target without access to future frames or controls. The same causal teacher initializes the few-step student, establishing a consistent causal formulation across teacher training, student distillation, and inference. Beyond aligning the temporal information boundary, Prefix Scoring matches supervision to the student's realized rollout context by evaluating each target under the cached student-generated prefix that produced it. Prefix Corruption further stabilizes training by perturbing unreliable prefixes produced early in training while preserving this target-context alignment. With a simple causal formulation, CMD naturally extends to frame-wise and chunk-wise generation, long video distillation, and camera-conditioned distillation. Experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art aggregate performance among autoregressive methods on both short- and long-video benchmarks, together with substantially improved adherence to time-varying camera controls.

articles.title_zh: 背景- 调制分解: 教师自递视频分解的因果
articles.content_zh: 互动自动回放视频生成既需要低纬度推出,也需要精确的在线控制. 少步分馏通过减少去诺化步骤来加速生成,而在线控制则强加了因果限制:帧和块应该依赖于生成期间的历史和可得到的控制. 然而,现有的视频发行匹配蒸馏管(DMD),经常使用双向教师来监督因果的几步生,这些教师得分是完整的剪辑. 因此,一个目标的分数可以取决于未来框架和在学生产生时没有的控制,使教师的监督与学生的因果信息集错配. 我们引入了Context-Matched Distillation(CMD),这是一个因果性的DMD框架,它将教师监督与每个目标生成时可获得的信息相配合. CMD用一个因果老师来取代双向全剪接分数,该老师对每个目标进行评价,而不能访问未来的帧或控制. 同一因果师从少步生入手,在师资培训,学生分馏,推论中建立起了一致的因果配方. Prefix Scoring除了对接时间信息边界外,还根据学生实现的展开上下文,通过在缓存学生生成的产生它的前缀下评价每个目标来匹配监督. 前缀 " 腐败 " 进一步稳定了培训,在保持这种目标文本一致的同时,干扰了培训初期生产的不可靠的前缀。 使用简单的因果配体,CMD自然延伸至帧相和分相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 实验显示,在短视和长视基准上,自旋式方法之间最先进的总性能,同时大大改进了对时间变化相机控制的遵守。

articles.title: When Is a Task Vector Enough? An Empirical Theory of Implicit Multimodal ICL
articles.content: Implicit multimodal in-context learning compresses demonstrations into internal interventions, ranging from static task vectors to query-conditioned transformations and attention routing. Despite their common goal, these methods differ substantially in how the intervention depends on the query and where it modifies the model, leaving unclear which additional complexity is necessary for a given task. We propose the Selection--Realization Hypothesis. It views demonstrations as inducing a compact family of internal changes from which the query selects, while the model's computation constrains how the selected change can be implemented. We evaluate this account using controlled multimodal tasks in which query dependence varies without changing the underlying task primitives or prompt format. By contrasting correct demonstrations with matched counterfactuals, we measure the structure of explicit M-ICL and test whether it predicts intervention behavior. We find that the success of a static task vector is closely tied to how much of the demonstration-induced change is shared across queries. Additional intervention complexity becomes useful when explicit M-ICL contains query-specific or distributed structure that a local additive shift cannot recover. These relationships extend to natural VQA benchmarks and support cost-aware method selection without access to test performance. Our results provide a unified empirical theory of when demonstrations can be compressed into a task vector and when a more expressive intervention is warranted.

articles.title_zh: 任务矢量什么时候够用? 隐形多式联运的经验理论
articles.content_zh: 隐含的多模式内文本学习将演示压缩成内部干预,从静态任务向量到有查询条件的转换和注意力的去向. 尽管它们有共同的目标,但这些方法在干预如何取决于查询和在哪些地方对模型进行修改方面差别很大,因此不清楚某项任务需要哪些额外的复杂性。 我们提出"选择-真实化假设". 它将演示视为诱导一个内部变化的紧凑家族,由查询从中选择,而模型的计算则制约了如何执行所选择的改变. 我们使用控制下的多模式任务来评价这个账户,其中查询依赖性不同,而不改变基本任务原始或即时格式。 通过将正确的演示与对应的反事实作对比,我们测量了显性M-ICL的结构并测试它是否预测了干预行为. 我们发现,静态任务矢量的成功与否与在各种查询中分享多少示范引起的变化密切相关。 当明确的M-ICL包含局部添加剂转移无法恢复的有特定查询或分布的结构时,额外的干预复杂性就变得有用了. 这些关系延伸到自然的VQA基准和支持成本意识方法选择,而无法获得测试性能. 我们的成果提供了一个统一的实证理论,说明何时可以将演示压缩成任务载体,何时有必要进行更明确的干预。

articles.title: Reconstructing Historical Manuscripts through MSI: The Potential of Contrast in Assessing Image Quality and Legibility
articles.content: Digital restoration of historical manuscript images aims to improve readability while preserving the authenticity of cultural heritage documents. However, evaluating quality of restored manuscripts remains challenging, where readability is often subjective and expert annotations are scarce. This study investigates the suitability of contrast-based image quality measures to assess quality and legibility of reconstructed manuscript images from multi-spectral imaging. Two experiments were conducted with publicly-available data sets, facilitating manual quality scores by experts and full-reference image quality measures as reference evaluations. The results show that potential contrast achieves the highest correlation with expert ratings, while contrast-to-noise ratio demonstrates the strongest agreement with full-reference quality measures. Overall, contrast-based measures consistently outperform general image quality measures, demonstrating their potential as objective indicators of manuscript legibility and reconstruction quality.

articles.title_zh: 重建历史 通过MSI的手稿:在评估图像质量和合法性方面的矛盾潜力
articles.content_zh: 数字修复历史手稿图像的目的是提高可读性,同时保留文化遗产文件的真实性. 然而,对修复的手稿质量的评估仍然具有挑战性,因为可读性常常是主观的,专家的说明也很少。 本研究调查了基于对比的图像质量措施是否适合评估从多光谱成像中重建的手稿图像的质量和可辨认性. 利用公开提供的数据集进行了两次试验,促进了专家的人工质量分数和将图像质量衡量标准作为参考评价。 结果显示,潜在对比与专家评级的关联度最高,而对比与噪声比率则表明,与全面参照的质量衡量标准最一致。 总的来说,以对比为基础的衡量标准一贯比一般图像质量衡量标准要好,显示出它们作为手稿可辨认性和重建质量的客观指标的潜力。

articles.title: Sign Language Video Synthesis via Loss-Guided Multi-Expert GANs
articles.content: This preliminary technical report presents a framework for sign language video synthesis using a loss-guided multi-expert Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) to enhance communication for individuals with hearing impairments. Three specialized discriminators -- global, hand, and head -- each guide a corresponding expert branch in the generator toward a distinct visual region, enabling implicit feature specialization without explicit diversity losses. To stabilize this multi-discriminator system, whose early-phase training otherwise exhibits chaotic dynamics, we introduce a United Loss consensus mechanism that regularizes each discriminator toward the ensemble average at a 10% weight. Each branch further adopts a dual-pathway convolutional-transformer design with learnable AdaptiveFeatureFusion, balancing the stability of convolutions against the detail of windowed self-attention. The generator is trained using an alternating three-mode schedule (discriminator, holistic generation, branch-specialized generation). On a custom 156GB dataset with a filtered test set that removes easy and repetitive samples, our 0.2B-parameter variant achieves 29.8 PSNR and the 1.3B-parameter variant achieves 30.7 PSNR, with inference VRAM footprints of 1.5 GB and 8 GB respectively, enabling deployment on consumer-grade hardware. Full ablation studies remain ongoing due to the 2-3 month training cycle on a single GPU. The system was showcased at the 2025 Hong Kong Frontier Technology Summit.

articles.title_zh: 通过Loss-Guideded多专家GANs进行手语视频合成
articles.content_zh: 这份初步技术报告介绍了手语视频合成的框架,使用损失制导多专家基因辅助网络(GAN)加强听力障碍个人的沟通. 三个专业歧视者 -- -- 全球、手和头 -- -- 都引导发电机中相应的专家分支走向一个独特的视觉区域,使隐含的特征专业化不会明显丧失多样性。 为了稳定这个多重歧视者系统,它的早期训练在其他方面显示出混乱的动态,我们引入了一个“联合损失”共识机制,使每个歧视者以10%的重量对综艺平均进行规范化。 每个分支都进一步采用可学习的可适应性变异(Adaptive Feature Fusion)的双向转录式转录式设计,平衡了转录的稳定性和窗口自意的细节. 发电机的培训采用交替的三模式时间表(歧视者、整体生成者、分支专用生成者)。 在一个带有过滤测试集的156GB数据集中,我们0.2B参数的变体实现29.8 PSNR,1.3B参数的变体实现30.7 PSNR,推断VRAM脚印分别为1.5 GB和8 GB,使得能够在消费级硬件上部署. 由于一个单一的GPU的培训周期为2至3个月,全面延期研究仍在进行。 2025年香港边疆科技峰会对该系统进行了展示.

articles.title: AmalthAI: An Open-Source Computer Vision Platform for Cultural Heritage
articles.content: Computer vision (CV) and machine learning (ML) offer new tools for cultural heritage (CH) artifact analysis, but the CV/ML pipeline remains largely inaccessible to CH domain experts, who lack the background to configure, train, or assess models. We present AmalthAI, an open-source CV platform that bridges this gap, enabling non-ML CH experts to independently produce and validate archaeologically meaningful findings. The interface covers dataset management, training, and inference for classification, segmentation, and object detection, with Kubeflow and Katib handling scalable training and hyperparameter search. Grad-CAM localizes the image region behind a prediction, and a vision-language model (VLM) adds a text description of it for expert review. Since archaeological data is often state-owned or rights-encumbered and cannot leave institutional custody, AmalthAI's self-hostable deployment ensures sensitive data is kept within premises. We test the platform on an archaeological use case built on a custom dataset of clay textile imprints, where CH experts trained and validated segmentation, and classification models for hypothesis testing. We provide the implementation code at https://github.com/TEXTaiLES/AmalthAI.

articles.title_zh: AmalthAI:文化遗产的开源计算机视野平台
articles.content_zh: 计算机视觉(CV)和机器学习(ML)为文化遗产(CH)文物分析提供了新的工具,但CH域专家仍然基本上无法使用CV/ML管道,他们缺乏配置、培训或评估模型的背景。 我们介绍的是AmalthAI,这是一个开源的CV平台,可以弥合这一差距,使非ML CH专家能够独立地产生和验证具有考古意义的结论。 该接口包括数据集管理、培训和分类、分解和物体探测的推论,包括Kubeflow和Katib处理可扩展培训和超参数搜索。 Grad-CAM在预测背后将图像区域本地化,而视觉语言模型(VLM)则增加了其文字描述,供专家审查. 由于考古数据往往为国有或权利所保障,不能离开机构保管,因此阿马尔特艾自行部署确保了敏感数据保存在房地内. 我们用一个基于粘土纺织印记的定制数据集的考古使用案例来测试平台,其中CH专家经过了培训和验证的分解,以及假说测试的分类模型. 我们在https://github.com/TEXTailES/AmalthAI上提供了执行守则。

articles.title: How Good are Foundation Models in Longitudinal MRI Disease Progression Reasoning?
articles.content: Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) interpretation is fundamental to clinical decision-making, requiring radiologists to integrate multi-view anatomical planes across sequential timepoints while precisely localizing interval changes. However, existing vision-language benchmarks remain confined to single-timepoint, single-view interpretation, failing to capture the temporal-spatial reasoning essential to radiologic practice. We introduce the Time-Aware Multi-View MRI Benchmark, an evaluation framework unifying multi-view anatomical input, temporal reasoning across longitudinal scans, and structured localization guidance. The benchmark comprises 3,920 expert-verified question-answer pairs derived from 890 patients across over 3,200 longitudinal MRI timepoints, drawn from seven clinical cohorts covering glioblastoma, neurodegeneration, vestibular schwannoma, and brain metastases, in open-ended, multiple-choice, and binary formats, requiring models to identify anatomical regions of maximal change, characterize progression across sequences and views, and provide structured guidance specifying boundaries, imaging features, and confounders. Experiments across 16 vision-language models reveal moderate temporal alignment but systematic failure on change direction recognition and volumetric quantification, while multi-view inputs improve spatial localization yet degrade temporal reasoning in compact architectures. Our benchmark provides a systematic framework for evaluating progression tracking, interval change localization, and temporal ordering, which are essential for clinical deployment. Code, evaluation splits, and the dataset are available at: https://github.com/wafaAlghallabi/Time-Aware-MRI.

articles.title_zh: 纵向核磁共振疾病进展原因方面的基础模型如何良好?
articles.content_zh: 磁共振成像(MRI)解释对临床决策至关重要,需要放射学家将多视解剖平面整合到相继时间点,同时精确地将间隔变化本地化. 然而,现有的视觉语言基准仍然局限于单一时间点、单一观点的解释,未能抓住放射学实践所必需的时间空间推理。 我们引入了"时间-智能多维磁共振基准"(Time-Aware Multi-View MRI Birgin),这是一个统一多视角解剖输入的评价框架,跨纵向扫描的时间推理,以及结构化本地化指导. 该基准包括3 920个经专家核实的对答,这些对答来自890名患者,跨越了3 200多个纵向磁共振时间点,取自7个临床组群,这些组群以开放式、多选择和二进制形式覆盖了胶原瘤、神经分泌、前缘schwannoma和大脑元体,需要模型确定最大变化的解剖区域,描述跨序列和观点的进展,并提供结构化指导,说明界限、成像特征和集合者。 16个视觉语言模型的实验显示,在时间上适度调整,但在变化方向识别和量子量化方面系统失败,而多视图投入则改善了空间局部化,但在紧凑结构中却降低了时间推理。 我们的基准为评价进展跟踪、间隔变化本地化和时间订购提供了系统框架,这对临床部署至关重要。 代码、评价划分和数据集见:https://github.com/wafaAlghallabi/Time-Aware-MRI。

articles.title: How Do VLMs Behave When Blind or Misled? Behavioral Evaluation of VLMs on Scientific Figures
articles.content:
Existing vision-language model (VLM) benchmarks emphasize perception and reasoning accuracy (how well VLMs describe and reason about what they see in an image), with limited attention to behavioral reliability under uncertainty (how they behave when visual evidence is missing or misleading). We introduce SciFigBench, a diagnostic VLM benchmark for scientific figure understanding that jointly evaluates perception, reasoning, and behavioral reliability under uncertainty. It contains 250 figures with high-quality human annotations across three evaluation aspects, totaling 600+ hours of annotation effort. We further extend these figures via image transformations, reasoning questions, resistance probes, caption-bias probes, and confirmed selective-blur targets, producing over 34,000 evaluation setups for stress testing.
  We further propose the Admittance-Resistance-Inductance (A-R-I) framework to evaluate whether models acknowledge insufficient evidence, resist misleading context, and infer cautiously from partial information. Our results reveal substantial behavioral differences among models. GPT-5.2 achieves the highest description quality (MQM 91.6) with strong reasoning accuracy (78.4%), yet hallucinates unreadable content in 96% of cases, whereas Gemini 3.1 Pro, a comparably capable model (MQM 90.2, reasoning 81.0%), admits uncertainty in 71% of such cases and achieves the strongest resistance score (0.91). These findings show that high perception and reasoning accuracy alone do not guarantee behavioral reliability, a dimension critical for deployment in scientific workflows.

articles.title_zh: 失明或误入歧途时,甚高频如何表现? 关于科学数字的自愿清单的行为评价
articles.content_zh:
现有的视觉语言模型(VLM)基准强调感知和推理的准确性(VLM如何描述和解释他们在图像中看到的事物),在不确定性(视觉证据缺失或误导时的行为)下对行为可靠性的关注有限. 我们引入了SciFig Bench, 一个用于科学人物理解的诊断性VLM基准, 在不确定性下共同评价感知,推理和行为可靠性. 它包含250个数字,在三个评价方面都有高质量的人文说明,总共需要600多小时的说明。 我们通过图像转换,推理问题,阻力探测器,字幕-比斯探测器,以及确认的选择性bulur目标进一步扩展这些数字,产生了超过34000个用于压力测试的评价设置.
我们进一步提出承认-抵抗-主动性(A-R-I)框架,以评估模型是否承认证据不足,抵制误导性上下文,并从部分信息中谨慎推断出. 我们的结果显示,模型之间的行为差异很大。 GPT-5.2的描述质量最高(MQM 91.6),推理精度强(78.4%),然而幻觉在96%的病例中无法读取内容,而双子座3.1 Pro,一种相仿的能力模型(MQM 90.2,推理81.0),承认了71%的病例的不确定性并实现了最强的阻力分数(0.91). 这些调查结果表明,光是高感知和推理准确性并不能保证行为的可靠性,而这对于科学工作流程中的部署至关重要。

articles.title: GeoCache: Training-Free Acceleration of Multi-View Texture Diffusion via Geometric Delta Transport
articles.content: Geometry-conditioned multi-view diffusion enables high-quality 3D texture generation, but its repeated per-view denoiser evaluations introduce substantial computational cost. Existing training-free accelerators primarily exploit temporal redundancy by reusing computation across denoising steps. In multi-view texturing, however, skipping a step also removes the cross-view interaction that continually aligns different observations of the same surface, leading to rapidly degraded consistency and fidelity. Our analysis identifies a complementary source of redundancy: although intermediate features remain view-specific, geometrically corresponding surface points exhibit transferable evolution in their predicted clean signals. Based on this observation, we introduce \gc{}, a training-free plugin that evaluates a rotating subset of anchor views and transports their geometry-aligned per-step $\xz$ updates to the remaining views. Periodic full-view computation controls accumulated error, while sampler-consistent reconstruction preserves the denoising trajectory. \gc{} requires neither retraining nor architectural modification and uses the position maps already available in geometry-conditioned texturing pipelines. Across Hunyuan3D-2.1, SyncMVD, and MVPainter, \gc{} achieves a stronger speed--fidelity trade-off than temporal caches and step reduction at operating points above $2\times$. On Hunyuan3D-2.1, it delivers a $2.21\times$ denoiser-loop speedup with an MV-LPIPS of 0.0293 and an MV-PSNR of 33.60 dB, providing the best fidelity among all tested methods above $2\times$. The same transferred configuration reaches the highest speedup and lowest FLOPs on SyncMVD, while \gc{} achieves the lowest FLOPs and best fidelity among the accelerated methods on MVPainter. These results establish cross-view geometry as an effective acceleration axis for multi-view texture diffusion.

articles.title_zh: GeoCache:通过几何三角洲运输实现多维纹理扩散的免费培训加速
articles.content_zh: 几何条件多视图传播可以使高品质的3D纹理生成,但其重复的每个视图的denoiser评价带来了大量的计算成本. 现有的无培训加速器主要利用时间冗余,在解禁步骤中重复计算。 然而,在多视图文本化中,跳出一个步骤也会去除交叉视图的交互作用,这些交互作用不断将同一地表的不同观测对齐,导致一致性和忠诚性迅速退化. 我们的分析确定了冗余的互补来源:虽然中间特征仍然是视向特定的,几何对应的地表点在预测的清洁信号中显示出可转移的演变. 基于这一观察,我们引入了\gc{},一个无训练插件,该插件可以评价一个旋转的子集锚地视图,并传送其几何相通的每步$\xz$对所余视图的更新. 定期全景计算控制器累积出错,而采样器-相容重建则保留了去诺克轨道. \gc{} 既不要求再培训,也不要求建筑改造,并使用在几何条件纹理管道中已经存在的位置图. 在Hunyuan3D-2.1,SyncMVD,和MVPainter,\gcQX实现比时间缓存更强大的速度-真实性取舍,并在超过2\times$的操作点实现分步削减. 在Hunyuan3D-2.1上,它提供2.21分乘以0.0293的MV-LPIPS和33.60分贝的MV-PSNR的速度,在所有测试方法中提供2分乘以以上的最佳忠诚度。 同样的被转移配置在SyncMVD上达到了最高速度和最低FLOP,而\gc{}在MVPainter上的加速方法中实现了最低的FLOP和最忠实. 这些结果将交叉视图几何设定为多视图纹理传播的有效加速轴.

articles.title: Reasoning for Social Audio-Visual Question Answering: Where Do We Stand?
articles.content: Training Multimodal Large Language Models for audio-visual social understanding is a crucial step toward embodied social intelligence. Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning has become the dominant approach, with HumanOmniV2 and its IntentBench benchmark as a prominent reference point. In this context, we report three findings. First, IntentBench is highly noisy: $\sim$7% of questions are broken and $\sim$23% are trivially answerable without the video input. We remove the affected questions and release Intentbench-Prime. Second, current reasoning approaches are expensive and surprisingly ineffective. A simple Vanilla SFT baseline matches or outperforms existing reasoning methods across three benchmarks at a fraction of the cost, establishing it as an essential baseline for evaluating novel fine-tuning techniques. Third, our analysis reveals that substantial priors can be learned solely from the text modality and that using a textual caption instead of the video yields performance on par with Vanilla SFT. These surprising findings reveal the limitations of current MLLMs when it comes to social understanding. IntentBench-Prime, Vanilla SFT model, and code are publicly available.

articles.title_zh: 社会视听问题的理由 回答:我们站在哪里?
articles.content_zh: 培训多式联运 大语言 视听社会理解模式是向体现社会智慧迈出的关键一步。 思维链(CoT)推理成为了主导方法,HumanOmniV2及其Intent Bench基准是突出的参考点. 在这方面,我们报告三项调查结果。 首先,本奇特意非常吵:7%的问题被打破,23%的问题在没有视频输入的情况下得到微小回答。 我们删除受影响的问题 释放Intentbench-Prime。 第二,目前的推理方法昂贵,效果惊人。 一个简单的香草SFT基线以成本的一小部分匹配或超过现有三个基准的推理方法,将其确立为评价新微调技术的基本基线. 第三,我们的分析显示,仅从文本模式即可了解大量前科,使用文字标题而不是视频可以产生与Vanilla SFT同等的性能。 这些出人意料的调查结果揭示了在社会理解方面,目前最低劳动保障的局限性。 意向奔驰-Prime,香草SFT型号,并公开提供代码.

articles.title: CoverPrune: Coverage-Driven Token Pruning for 3D VLMs via Optimal Transport
articles.content: While 3D Vision-Language Models (3D VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable spatial reasoning capabilities, they suffer from massive visual token counts that create severe computational bottlenecks during inference. Existing token pruning methods primarily rely on diversity-based selection, discarding similar tokens to maximize dispersion. However, in 3D environments, this approach frequently drops representative prototype tokens in favor of outliers, breaking the multi-view consistencies and geometric structures essential for spatial reasoning. In this paper, we propose a paradigm shift for 3D VLM token pruning: from maximizing diversity to preserving visual evidence coverage. We introduce CoverPrune, a training-free framework that formulates inference-time token pruning as an Optimal Transport (OT) problem. To overcome the intractable combinatorial subset selection inherent in this formulation, we design the Feature-Spatial-Temporal (FST) transport cost and target capacity, along with an efficient Spatial-Guided Greedy Selection (SGS) algorithm to approximate the OT objective. Furthermore, we propose CoverPrune-Lite, an accelerated variant utilizing spatially structured local matching for minimal overhead. Extensive experiments across multiple 3D visual-spatial reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that our methods achieve state-of-the-art token efficiency, maintaining robust reasoning performance even under highly aggressive pruning budgets. Visit our project website at https://github.com/Brucess/CoverPrune.

articles.title_zh: 封面普鲁恩:通过优化运输为3D VLM 进行覆盖 - Driven Token Pruning
articles.content_zh: 虽然3D Vision-Language Models(3D VLMs)表现出出众的空间推理能力,但它们却遭受了巨大的视觉符号计数,在推论中造成了严重的计算瓶颈. 现有的代币套接法主要依靠基于多样性的选择,放弃类似的代币以最大限度地分散. 然而,在三维环境中,这种方法往往会掉入有代表性的原型符号而偏好外观,打破了空间推理所必需的多视图组成和几何结构. 在本文中,我们提议为3D VLM 标志性搜索进行范式转变:从尽可能扩大多样性到保留视觉证据覆盖. 我们引入了CoverPrune,一个无培训框架,将推论时标注为最佳运输(OT)问题。 为了克服这种配方中固有的难以解决的组合子集选择,我们设计了Feature-Spatial-Temporal(FST)运输成本和目标能力,同时设计了高效的空间定向贪取(SGS)算法来取近似OT目标. 此外,我们提议采用CoverPrune-Lite这一加速变体,利用空间结构的本地匹配来尽量减少间接费用。 跨越多条3D视觉-空间推理基准的广泛实验表明,我们的方法实现了最先进的象征性效率,即使在极具攻击性的预算下也保持了稳健的推理性能. 访问我们的项目网站https://github.com/Brucess/CoverPrune。

articles.title: Reliability analysis for BraTS-GoAT segmentation: a controlled robustness study of deep-ensemble uncertainty
articles.content: Deep networks segment brain tumours accurately in-distribution, but can fail silently when the input differs from their training data. That risk is central to clinical deployment and is the premise of the BraTS-GoAT generalizability task. We ask not only how well a model segments, but whether its uncertainty knows when it is wrong. On BraTS-GoAT (Task 3) we train a 5-fold cross-validated nnU-Net baseline (one held-out prediction per case) and a 3-seed deep ensemble. Both are evaluated for calibration and error detection on a per-region relevant mask, aggregated per case. In-distribution the 3-seed ensemble improves modestly over the already strong single model on the same held-out split, with the clearest gain in calibration. The separation appears under shift. In a controlled robustness study using graded synthetic corruptions as a proxy for acquisition shift, the single model's confidence stays flat while its accuracy and calibration degrade. Inter-member disagreement instead rises steeply, about a quarter to a third above the clean condition, several times the single model's response. On the official validation leaderboard the 5-fold ensemble of those folds attains whole-tumour Dice 0.87. The generalization gap is concentrated on the harder regions, with a characteristic failure of missing small, satellite lesions on unseen cohorts. In the synthetic study, disagreement among the 3-seed members is a more sensitive case-level indicator of acquisition shift than single-model confidence. Its per-voxel error localisation weakens as severity grows. The contribution is a rigorous, honest reliability comparison rather than a claim that any one uncertainty method dominates.

articles.title_zh: BRATS-GOAT分解的可靠性分析:关于深度不确定性的可控强性研究
articles.content_zh: 深层网络将脑瘤精确地分解,但当输入与其训练数据不同时,可以无声地失败. 这种风险是临床部署的核心,也是BrATS-GOAT通用性任务的前提. 我们不仅询问模范部分有多好,而且问其不确定性是否知道何时是错误的。 在BrATS-GOAT(任务3)上,我们训练了5倍跨验证的nnU-Net基线(每个病例一个被搁置的预测)和一个3种深层综艺节目. 对两者都进行了评估,以在每一区域的相关口罩上校正和发现出错,并按个案汇总。 分出分出 三种子合唱团在相同被搁置分出时,比已经很强的单相模式稍有改进,在校正上收益最明显. 分离似乎在转变中。 在利用分级合成腐败作为获取转移的代名词的受控强性研究中,单一模型的置信度保持平平,而其精度和校正则会下降. 会员之间的分歧反而陡然上升,比清洁状态高出了约四分之一至三分之一,是单一型号反应的多倍. 在官方的验证领导板上,这些折叠的5倍共通度达到全图图定分0.87. 普遍化的差距集中在较困难的地区,在看不见的群体中,缺失的小型和卫星损害是典型的失败。 在合成研究中,3种种子成员之间的分歧是比起单型置信度更敏感的购入级转移指标. 其每伏克赛尔出错的定位会随着严重程度的增长而减弱. 其贡献是严格、诚实的可靠性比较,而不是声称任何一种不确定性方法都占主导地位。

articles.title: UniCon-Former: Unified Convolution Transformer is All You Need for Hand Gesture Recognition
articles.content: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) capture local features efficiently but struggle with global context due to their limited receptive field. On the other hand, transformers effectively capture global dependencies through self-attention but suffer from high redundancy and computational costs. Thus, to leverage the advantages of both CNNs and transformers, we propose a unified model (UniCon-Former) that aims to provide robust and efficient performance on dynamic hand gesture recognition. The unified approach helps the model to learn both local and global features. At the beginning of each transformer stage, the convolution projections help in decreasing the dimension of the input vectors of the transformer block. This creates a pyramidal structure at each transformer stage. These features enable the UniCon-Former to reduce resource usage than vanilla transformers, making it flexible for learning multi-scale and high-resolution features, which is required in hand gesture recognition. We have performed experiments with NVGesture and Briareo datasets and achieved state-of-the-art results with fewer parameters and MACs.

articles.title_zh: UniCon-Former: 统一革命变形器是手势识别所需的全部
articles.content_zh: 革命神经网络(CNNs)高效地捕捉了当地的地物,但因接受范围有限而与全球环境相搏. 另一方面,变压器通过自觉有效地捕捉全球依赖性,但承受了高冗余和高计算成本. 因此,为了利用CNN和变压器的优势,我们提出一个统一的模型(UniCon-Former),目的是在动态手势识别上提供有力而高效的性能. 统一办法有助于该模式学习地方和全球特点。 在每个变压器阶段起步时,回旋预测有助于降低变压器块入向量的尺寸. 这在每一个变压器阶段都形成了一个金字塔结构. 这些功能使得UniCon-Former能够比香草变压器减少资源用量,使得它能够灵活地学习多尺度和高分辨率的特性,这是手势识别中需要的. 我们用NVGesture和Briareo数据集进行了实验,并以较少的参数和MAC实现了最先进的结果.

articles.title: NARU: A Benchmark for NARrative Evolution and Cultural Nuance Understanding in Japanese Extreme Long Video
articles.content: Long-form video understanding encompasses tasks that go beyond retrieving isolated events, including tracking an evolving narrative and interpreting social meaning that may remain implicit. However, existing benchmarks rarely evaluate these capabilities jointly, particularly in high-context, non-English media. To address this gap, we introduce NARU, a benchmark designed to evaluate Narrative evolution and Reasoning on cultural Understanding in Japanese long-form video. NARU consists of 1,481 questions grounded in 155 videos totaling 146.8 hours, spanning four narrative and five cultural dimensions. To construct the benchmark at this scale, we propose a hierarchical memory-based annotation pipeline that transforms raw video into structured event, narrative, and cultural annotations, then generates questions via task-oriented synthesis and iterative shortcut removal. The construction process includes two native-speaker verification stages involving 68 annotators. Evaluations across eight model configurations reveal substantial limitations in both long-range narrative integration and culturally grounded reasoning. By exposing these persistent gaps, NARU offers a systematic testing ground for developing MLLMs capable of reliably interpreting long-form, high-context video.
